messages:
maria (newhire): hey team — accepted the GitHub invite but the org doesn't show up on my account. clicking the invite link just gives a 404. also getting blocked by 2FA setup when I try to join. who should I ping to get my account fully provisioned? @it-support ? :wave:
it-support: hi maria — welcome! which email did you accept the invite with? we require SSO + 2FA for org access. if the link expired we can resend. please DM your GitHub username so we can re-run the invite flow quickly.
maria (newhire): thanks — used maria.dev+redwood@gmail.com. my GitHub username is mariag
it-support: ok resending invite now. note: you may see a prompt that says "Organization requires SAML SSO" — click "Connect to SSO" and then enable 2FA if prompted. here's GH 2FA doc: https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/securing-your-account-with-two-factor-authentication-2fa/adding-2fa
onboard-bot: Automated message — To finish onboarding please: 1) Accept org invite 2) Connect SSO 3) Enable 2FA 4) Add SSH key -> https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/git
ben: @mariag once you're in we'll add you to the eng team and grant repo access to redwood-inference/runtime and redwood-inference/console. tell me if you need push rights or just read/PR.
elaine: quick SSH tip: if you already have a key run `cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub | gh ssh-key add -t "mariag workstation" -` or go to Settings -> SSH and GPG keys in the web UI.
it-support: invite resent at 2024-03-25T14:07Z — check the invite email (also try incognito/clear cache if you hit 404). if it still fails we can manually add you via email match and force SSO link.
maria (newhire): got it — email arrived, 2FA set up, accepted invite and connected SSO. I can see the redwood-inference org now, thanks everyone :tada:
ben: added you to team "eng" and granted repo read + PR access on runtime. infra/private repos will come next after a brief security review.
maria (newhire): verified I can clone `git@github.com:redwood-inference/runtime.git` and opened my first tiny PR to fix a typo. thanks for the fast help! 👍
it-support: closing this thread — re-open or ping us in #help if anything else is broken. :white_check_mark:
